svg.title: Scene 3 case 2: I'm depressed!
svg.desc: Raka sits with his head bowed and both hands holding his head after missing a work target. A separate target progress marker cues the failure; the terracotta label says I'm depressed! and a sage correction says sadness after failure is a normal emotion.
svg.metadata: Student Stress · Rafiki supplies the study setting; Co-workers · Rafiki supplies the same Raka as Scene 4B and 4A. The target progress marker, mistaken label, and sage correction are independent editable overlays; no generated imagery.
